integrity: Hoover's complete 1985 three-page article was inspected for the physical-time equations and canonical-density construction. The full open Mahdi–Valls preprint was inspected for the exact polynomial oscillator, Darboux-integrability theorem, and mathematical classification. The complete 2019 Hoover–Sprott–Hoover article was inspected and establishes that the global kinetic-temperature balance, zero mean thermostat friction, and z=0 crossing implications are prior. Invariant-torus and qualitative-dynamics sources were compared at statement and implication level. The accepted conditional laws, strict variance defect, and |x|=1 compact-recurrence crossing theorem were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compact invariant probability measures and compact invariant sets.
The conditional law fixes only the first conditional moment of squared momentum, not its full conditional distribution.
The result does not imply canonical Gaussian statistics or ergodicity.
The known global kinetic-temperature balance, zero mean thermostat friction, and z=0 crossing theorem are excluded from the originality claim.
A differently phrased equivalent fiberwise observation could remain in unindexed thermostat literature.
title: Fiberwise kinetic-temperature calibration in the Nosé–Hoover oscillator
